summary: Ansible is agentless: install it on one control node and manage many machines remotely over SSH, PowerShell remoting and other transports, with no database or daemons.
questions: Does Ansible need a database or a server daemon?
How does Ansible connect to the machines it manages?

answer_card.title: How Ansible is installed and connects
answer_card.answer_md: Install Ansible on a single **control node**. From there it manages other machines (managed nodes) over SSH, PowerShell remoting and other transports. No agents, databases or daemons are needed.
